title: Two Prices for One Loaf
story: The bakery on Mill Street raised the price of a loaf on Monday. Tomas usually bought bread there after work. He compared the new price with the supermarket down the hill. The supermarket loaf cost less, but it was a longer walk. Tomas checked his weekly budget in a notes app. He could still buy the bakery loaf if he skipped a magazine. He liked supporting the small shop, so he chose that. He paid with cash and put the coins from his change into a jar at home. His sister Ines said the supermarket was smarter. Tomas explained that the bakery used local flour and stayed open late.
